verdict.rationale: The evidence shows FFmpeg's source is publicly readable in its GitHub repository (FFmpeg/FFmpeg), which documents libraries such as libavfilter and libavformat and a doc/examples directory. A community user also reports reading FFplay's source. No item in the pack states the license terms, so the 'open license' half of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an open-source license (e.g., LGPL/GPL terms), independent corroboration of licensing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
